title: ClueCon Weekly – Kamailio Updates – July 2020
html:
A few weeks ago it was recorded a new edition of ClueCon Weekly about what is new in Kamailio project, featuring the host David Duffett, community manager at Signalwire, and the guest Daniel-Constantin Mierla, co-founder of Kamailio project.

The video was released recently on their youtube channel, the link it is at:

  •   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3dhN5YxGIXo

The content tried to highlight a couple of the major events and contributions that happened for the Kamailio project during the past 12 months.

The host and the guests were several thousands of mile away from each other, and maybe you can spot some synchronization issues between them due to overloaded infrastructure caused by the pandemic lock down, but overall the recording worth watching, providing useful information if you use or plan to use Kamailio project.

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
